evidence.snippet: The systeme.io MCP server allows AI applications to access specific contact-management tools within your account.
Welcome to the Systeme.io MCP Server overview. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard designed to connect AI models with external data and tools.

decisions.reason: Pages confirm systeme.io publishes its own official MCP server and documentation, but no page text gives the literal server connection URL (e.g. mcp.systeme.io/mcp), only the docs page URL, so the exact endpoint cannot be verified from the provided evidence.
